56
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 4, 2006/Sravana 6, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Revival plan for sick fertilizer units
*181. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are working on a proposal to revive eight
sick or closed public sector fertilizer
factories in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
estimated time frame alongwith the cost
for the revival;
(c) whether the revival of these factories
will be sufficient to meet the growing
demand of fertilizers in the country; and
(d) if not, in what way Government
propose to meet the excess demand?
Malaria control in North Eastern
Region
*182. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has established
a wing at Guwahati to control/fight malaria
epidemic affecting the lives of the people
of North Eastern States every year
resulting in loss of lives of poor villagers;
(b) what was the amount sanctioned
during 2004-05 and 2005-06 for Assam to
combat AIDS/HIV cases; and
(c) what are the actions taken by the
State Government in this connection?
Security arrangements at stations
†*183. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite bomb
explosions in Mumbai no strict arrange-
ments of security on various railway
stations including the capital have been made;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that at
the most important station of the capital,
most of the door metal detectors are either
out of order or not functioning properly;
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to take steps to improve the security

arrangements on various railway stations
including those of the capital; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Stoppage of wastage and value
addition under horticulture
mission
*184. SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Rs. 15,000
crore horticulture mission is taking big
steps forward as agricultural scientists are
coming up with do's and don'ts for
preventing the colossal waste of fruits and
vegetables in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
agricultural scientists are working on the
linkages for intensifying efforts for value
addition in fruits and vegetables as part of
the horticulture mission; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Second Green Revolution
†*185. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chairman
of National Commission on Farmers, Dr.
M.S. Swaminathan has underlined the need
for Second Green Revolution in the
country;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there is
need of making dry land or land dependent
on rain useful upto the maximum level in
order to bring Second Green Revolution in
the country;
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(e) the scheme being prepared by
Government for Second Green Revolution?
Vacancies in Indian Council of
Agricultural Research
*186. SHRIMATI  SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) how many posts of scientific nature
are vacant in the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research;
(b) the reasons for not filling these
posts;
(c) whether keeping so many posts
vacant has not hindered the progress of
various research schemes; and
(d) how long it would take to fill all
these vacant posts?
Wastage of stored wheat and rice
†*187. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) the quantity of grains deteriorated
out of wheat and rice stocked by the Food
Corporation of India during the last three
years, year-wise;
(b) the quantity of wheat used as animal
feed out of it and the quantity which was
not fit even for the said purpose; and
(c) the details of scheme by the Central
Government in order to improve the storage
system?

Drive' in a whole range of issues from
forestry to naming affluent plants and
monitoring the pollution; and

sectors of in

Vehicular pollution
1174. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether due to the increased use of
vehicles in the country the vehicular
pollution load has gone up eight times in
twenty years indicating a dire warning;
(b) the steps taken by Government
especially, to curb the air pollution keeping
in the view the increased use of vehicles;
and
(c) Government's policy on advanced
technology solutions for the automobile
industries to control air pollution?
Import of wheat
1175. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to import wheat recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of wheat production in
our country in the last five years, year-
wise and State-wise;
(d) the details of wheat procurement
by Government and its agencies, year-wise
and State-wise;
(e) the MSP offered to the wheat
farmers, year-wise;
(f) the procurement price offered by
Government during the last five years, year-
wise;
(g) the details of the general market
prices for wheat purchase by the private
traders, year-wise; and
(h) the price on which the Government
have decided to import wheat?
Milk production
†1176. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of share of Rajasthan
in the total production of milk in the
country;

271
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the per capita availability of milk in
Rajasthan, Punjab and Haryana; and
(c) the details of production of milk
during the last three years under white
revolution scheme of the Central
Government?
Employment opportunities in
Agriculture  sector
†1177. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether employment opportunities
in agricultural and its ancillary sectors are
continuously diminishing;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether according to the National
Sample Survey, 40 per cent of the farmers
are intended to avoid Agriculture ; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
raise the development rate and employment
opportunities in  Agriculture  sector?
Fund for afforestation by JBIC
1178. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Japanese
Bank of International Co-operation (JBIC)
has agreed to finance Rs. 613.26 crore for
afforestration scheme in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the total amount received,
so far, from JBIC and the conditions
imposed by the bank for sanctioning the
loan;
(c) the details of various programmes
proposed to be undertaken in this plan;
(d) whether the amount is reallocated
to all the district for implementation; and
(e) the present status of this project?
Seed and fertilizers subsidy to
farmers
1179. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) the quantum of subsidy being paid
to farmers to purchase seeds and fertilizers
for farming activities;
(b) whether the subsidy is distributed
equally to small and marginal farmers;
(c) the parameters considered while
distributing the subsidy; and
(d) the programmes launched by
Government to educate the farmers in
adopting modern agricultural technology?
Implementation of NAIS
1180. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the States and the Union Territories
where the National Agricultural Insurance
Scheme (NAIS) has not been implemented;
(b) the details thereof and the reasons
therefor;
(c) the time by which this scheme is
likely to be implemented in all the States;
and
(d) the details of the insurance
companies implementing NAIS?

272
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Promotion of horticulture in Assam
1181. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of areas identified in the
State of Assam to promote horticulture;
and
(b) the details of financial assistance
allocated by Government to develop the
horticulture in the State during the last three
years?
Mobile storage for containting
wastage of foodstuffs

Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
Rs. 50,000 crore of agricultural foodstuffs

(c) whether Government
